d:
From a historic Wild West hotel and a notorious farm to the eerie halls of an old jail, every location has a story that refuses to stay buried. Zak Bagans and the Ghost Adventures crew investigate places marked by disturbing histories and reports of unexplained activity. With every lockdown, strange encounters and unsettling discoveries raise more questions about what might still linger within these walls. How much will the crew uncover?
Watch Ghost Adventures, Season 9, Episodes 6, 7, 8, 9, 10, 11 and 13, on Discovery Channel India.
